about: The release note draft for 0.2.0. Every line is checked by claim-seal against this version's changelog section on the maintainer's own computer before the tag (scripts/seal-release-note.sh); the result is committed as 0.2.0.sealed.json and the release workflow only re-verifies it offline (scripts/release/release_note.py).
lede: Composer 0.2.0 is the full app, on your computer or your own server.

items.insight: One command installs the app on macOS and Linux: it finds Python 3.10 or newer or gets a private one, and installs Composer into one folder, ~/.lensmith-composer.
Every file the installer fetches is checked against a SHA-256 pinned in the script.
The app runs at http://127.0.0.1:8765/ with a phone-width page, your saved briefs, an optional daily brief and a weekly backup.
Optional narration reads the brief's own spoken script aloud with Kokoro, made on your computer after the text is final.
Composer can run on your own server, with a container image, a Compose file with Caddy in front for HTTPS and one login, and a step-by-step guide.
The insight cards carry no claim marks; the checked claims are marked in the opened insight sheet.
The one-command install ends by naming the optional extras (lensmith composer setup --reconfigure parser, provider, checker, narration, schedule or port); it still asks one question.
The installer no longer stops on a Mac with a chmod error.
